title: Ultrafiltration Process Design for Plant Protein Ingredient Manufacturing: Fouling Mechanisms and Scale-Up Parameters

record.title: Ultrafiltration Process Design for Plant Protein Ingredient Manufacturing: Fouling Mechanisms and Scale-Up Parameters
record.programme: Provincial Secretariat for Higher Education and Scientific Research
record.summary: This project investigates the specific fouling challenges associated with plant-derived protein streams, including pea, sunflower, and soy protein isolates, during ultrafiltration processing. Work packages cover physicochemical characterisation of plant protein aggregates at industrially relevant pH and ionic strength ranges, systematic fouling and cleaning experiments on polymeric and ceramic membranes, and development of scale-up correlations for cross-flow velocity and TMP for a planned 50 m² pilot facility at one industry partner. The project responds to growing regional interest in plant-based protein ingredients and includes a student internship programme with two participating food companies.
